vulnerable_statements.reason: On POST_PMD the runtime allocated in the PRE_PMU path is freed but substream->runtime is left pointing at the freed memory. The substream (w->priv) persists across power cycles, so a later event, error path, or another POST_PMD (e.g. after a failed PRE_PMU or repeated power-down) can dereference or kfree the stale pointer again, causing a use-after-free / double free.

suggested_fix: After freeing, clear the pointer: `kfree(substream->runtime); substream->runtime = NULL;`. This makes any later kfree a no-op and lets code that checks the pointer see that the runtime is gone. Also make sure the PRE_PMU error path frees and clears the runtime the same way.
